# Role matrix (الأدوار والصلاحيات)

Arabic text: provisional. It has not been checked by a qualified Arabic reviewer.

<!-- Generated by tools/release/role-matrix.mjs. Do not edit by hand: run `node tools/release/role-matrix.mjs --write`; `--check` fails on any difference (ADR-0072 §4, T-H3). -->

These roles and permissions are the platform's configurable starting point, not a Mobily-approved access policy.

<p dir="rtl" lang="ar">هذه الأدوار والصلاحيات هي نقطة البداية القابلة للتهيئة في المنصة، وليست سياسة وصول معتمدة من موبايلي.</p>

## How to read this matrix

- **Source.** `packages/shared/src/permissions.ts` (`PERMISSIONS`, `ROLES`), the object that `packages/db/src/seed.test.ts` pins to the seed migrations. The English and Arabic names and descriptions are the seeded rows of `packages/db/migrations/`.
- **Starting point only.** The database is the runtime source of truth. An access administrator assigns roles at a scope (organization, business unit, transformation) and may change the defaults after installation, so a running installation can differ from this table (Administration > Users and Assignments).
- **Cells.** `✓` means the role holds the permission by default. An empty cell means it does not.
- **Scope.** A role marked _inherits downward_ that is granted at a wider scope also applies to the narrower scopes inside it. The other roles apply only at the scope they are assigned.
- **Business approvals.** The permissions in the business-approval and Finance-validation categories are approvals **inside the product** (for example the product gates G1–G6). They are recorded per person and per decision. No technical-administration role holds one by default, and no service identity can hold one (ADR-0053). These product approvals are unrelated to the engineering delivery gates DG0–DG7.
- **Size.** 14 roles and 193 permissions. The Arabic texts are provisional.
